bullets: SKILL.md Fidelity rule: forbid regenerating/overwriting whole .xaml files and require verbatim preservation of ALL user-visible text (labels, headers, Description blocks), not just compile-relevant identifiers — agent had regenerated pages, relabeling buttons and dropping descriptions (50/100).

Add visible-text fidelity guard: bootstrap snapshots each copied XAML's labels/descriptions to .fidelity-snapshot.json; validator gains a WARN-only Section 8 flagging snapshotted text missing from migrated pages, catching regenerated/paraphrased pages the build gate can't see.
deferred_to_human: Promote the visible-text fidelity WARN to a hard FAIL once a tolerant matcher is proven low-false-positive across scenarios.
